newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea mulls new bourse section for small firms.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea mulls new bourse section for small firms.

text.p: South Korea is considering setting up a third-tier stock market section for trading in small and medium-sized companies only, trade minister Lim Chang-yeul said on Thursday.
"We are discussing steps for setting up a third-tier section for the market, specialising in trading small- and medium-sized companies," Lim told a news conference.
He said South Korea would shift its focus from protecting smaller firms to helping them improve.
"We will concentrate on measures to encourage the setting up of new firms and improving the competitiveness of smaller firms," he said.
